record_operation: Performed present target assignment and evidence curation; no physical experiment performed for this record.
candidate_scope: A proposed comparison of future moulded composites using three stock-origin nominal charged-dry-input accounting categories. Input, wet dispersion, conditioned powder, moulded composite and local measurement are separate stages.

primary_source.main_text_access: Verified original coauthor-uploaded cached text; no raw main-PDF bytes or complete graphical verification asserted.
primary_source.license: No permissive license established; bounded factual source context and locators only.

composition.selection_status: Newly chosen PROPOSED verification targets, assigned in this performed record.
composition.basis: Nominal charged dry-input mass fraction, partitioned once by stock origin; excludes carrier water and does not assert final retained mass.

category_definitions.nanotube_SDS_stock_dry_category: All allocated non-water input mass from the received nanotube/SDS stock, including its reagent and impurity residues.
category_definitions.PEDOT_PSS_stock_dry_category: All allocated non-water input mass from the conductive-polymer stock, including both polymers and any other stock residues.
category_definitions.PS_latex_stock_dry_category: All allocated non-water input mass from the PS-latex stock, including its own surfactant and any other stock residues.

composition.normalization: All selected fractions are positive; both vectors sum exactly to one. Both primitive denominators divide 10^19, so these belong to both the finite grid and unrestricted rational domain.
composition.accounting_prerequisites: Specify conditioning and delivered non-water mass assays before physical charging. Allocate every stock-carried residue exactly once; received nanotube impurities remain inside that origin category. Do not assume three pure substances or infer stock volume from unmeasured dry solids.
composition.qualification: These are present model targets, not reported blend proportions, source-precision upgrades, elemental fractions, purified nanotube fractions, actual delivered dry residue or measured retained product.

rejected_route_shortcut.status: REJECTED as a shortcut for the unchanged nominal source stock route; not a universal impossibility result.
rejected_route_shortcut.original_attempt: Four normalized categories had independently assigned received nanotube input 7/2000 and SDS 1/1000, alongside polymer categories.
rejected_route_shortcut.source_locator: Original Methods, printed page 368, SWCNT dispersions.
rejected_route_shortcut.nominal_source_ratio: Listed SW:SDS solute-mass coordinates 1:4; active-versus-reagent, extra residues and actual delivered mass require their own convention.
rejected_route_shortcut.boundary: Under the stipulated two-solute convention without unproved loss, the unchanged nanotube stock already exceeds the attempted SDS allocation before PS-stock surfactant. No removal, purification or mass disappearance is invented. A different route would need its own support; exact residue composition remains unmeasured.

source_context.material_stage: Published inputs and source composite discussion, not a new candidate assay.
source_context.statement: Component dimensions and dispersion/network context are reported. Orientation interpretation and constituent-only imaging do not establish complete final-composite structure.

candidate_structure.statement: No new constituent dimensions, orientation distribution, interface population, void fraction or dispersion measurement is supplied. Stock origin is an accounting identity rather than an exhaustive molecular identity.

source_context.statement: The attributed latex route is retained in the application; it is not automatically a completed route to these newly assigned stock-origin targets.

candidate_preparation.statement: Resolve stock grades/lots, conditioning, dry-input delivery and route applicability. Mix a fully recorded stock formulation, then specify actual powder conditioning and moulding histories. No stock has been delivered or composite prepared for this record.

candidate_success.statement: No yield, material loss, retained-residue amount or successful repetition is asserted.

source_context.statement: Four-point DC context is reported; composition tolerance and candidate sampling are separate inquiries.

candidate_measurement.statement: No new delivered-mass assay, retained composition, conductivity, geometry/current verification, raw data, fit domain or replicate uncertainty is supplied.

verification_tests.statement: Quantify stock-carried residues, wet and conditioned delivery, retained composition and sampling. Separately measure four-point DC with specified geometry/current/temperature, contact controls and replicate uncertainty; characterize network structure.

source_context.material_stage: Published composites, not the input vector or new candidate.
source_context.locator: Original fabrication discussion, Figure 2 and theory/Monte Carlo discussion.
source_context.statement: The source distinguishes cooperative experimental mixtures from theoretical antagonistic behavior. The latter is not a measured reversal.

source_coordinate_representation.qualification: The number is contextual source-coordinate conversion. The stock-category target basis is different or unresolved, so numerical bracketing does not establish a candidate threshold crossing or predict its conductivity.

candidate_result.material_stage: Any newly prepared and moulded candidate.
candidate_result.statement: No exact conductivity, observed unexpected result or complete property prediction is asserted. Conductivity is not assigned to the charged-input vector.

unsupported_extension.statement: Component targets alone do not determine elemental inventory, final network or every future electrical response.

property_scenario.temporal_status: Present unperformed verification informed by existing literature; not an applicant prediction predating that literature.
property_scenario.baseline_material_and_state: A future moulded composite prepared from the baseline three-stock targets, after resolving delivery, retained-residue and processing conditions; measured at a defined equilibrated temperature. This is not a source specimen.
property_scenario.controlled_change: Replace 1/1000 PS-stock dry-category fraction with 1/1000 PEDOT:PSS-stock dry-category fraction at fixed nanotube/SDS-stock category. Hold stock identities, conditioning, moulding schedule and measurement geometry/current/temperature fixed as specified prerequisites; do not claim total SDS is thereby fixed.
property_scenario.proposed_response: Hypothesis: increased positive DC conductivity if the substitution produces more effective mixed transport contacts and connected pathways. No magnitude, significance or threshold crossing is promised.
property_scenario.mechanism: Conditional improvement in effective network/charge-transfer connectivity, motivated by source models rather than established for a new specimen.
property_scenario.conditions: Specify lot identities, input-mass convention, actual processing and electrical protocol before implementation. Changing PS-stock amount can also change carrier residues; the pair alone does not isolate a pure-polymer effect.
property_scenario.discriminating_test: Compare recorded stock-category formulations using delivered/retained-residue assays, contact-controlled four-point DC, network characterization and replicate uncertainty. Separately design complete carrier-matched control allocations before attributing a response solely to one polymer; those controls are not source-performed corrections.

credible_alternative.hypothesis: Unchanged conductivity within a defined resolution, or reduced positive conductivity, if effective tube paths are disrupted while mixed contacts transfer charge poorly.
credible_alternative.mechanism: A different network/contact state, potentially coupled to changed carrier residues, can offset added conductive material; candidate pathways remain unmeasured.
credible_alternative.scope: A separate conditional hypothesis, not simultaneous opposites for the identical specimen/conditions and not a measured source reversal.

publication_boundary: These exact targets, rejection and evidence records are present curation, not attributed backward to 2011 or presumed included in a historical application/PDF. Statutory dates and effects remain unresolved.
